synopsis: In this episode of Mahanagar Season 2, DB Officer Sukumar Borua arrives in Dhaka to track down a missing girl named Zara Hayat Khan, leading him to confront the powerful Afnan Chowdhury. Meanwhile, Officer Harun navigates political pressure and police corruption surrounding the hasty arrest of an innocent man, Masum, whose tragic fate in custody threatens to unravel a larger conspiracy.
